brief: @buildthis.bisks.net i enter my account (1), i enter an account(2) i want to follow across all appviews, scans (2) repo for all profile schema, creates a follow record (1) for each created, then shows links to each appview to login and check follow
note: Follow-everywhere: scans an account's repo for every *.profile record and creates follows on Bluesky, Tangled, Grain & Spark, with links to check each.
